# Inquiry Publishing Stack — Vault Interface entrypoint

Current component: Vault Interface
Role: provider-neutral public metadata contract. This repository is not a private vault or private control plane.

Default full-stack adoption:
full AHICP + full PPF + Vault Interface + project-owned content.

Privacy boundary:
Vault Interface exposes only approved public metadata. Original or unpublished project source remains private by default. Continuous Web may be prepared as restricted/authenticated until explicit human public-release authorization. Public links never authorize private-state retrieval.

Agent instruction:
Reconstruct the four-component ecosystem before cross-component configuration. For an ordinary new project, prefer workers-builds-native under the personal ChongLiuPhil account, with one short human-assisted GitHub → Cloudflare bootstrap and a required second-push automatic-deployment check. For Cloudflare work, follow the Starter Project Provisioning Contract, shared operational contract, and pinned PPF provider runbooks. Provider credential plaintext must never enter Vault metadata, Git, or chat/model context. Agent-provisioned external CI and the Trusted Secret Broker remain optional advanced infrastructure; public release and other reserved gates still require separate human authorization.

Public delivery migration:
The four public framework sections now use one verified Cloudflare Worker at https://inquirystack.philohub.workers.dev/. GitHub remains canonical source; former GitHub Pages sites have been retired.
Migration guide: https://github.com/ChongLiuPhil/Inquiry-Publishing-Project-Starter/blob/main/docs/CLOUDFLARE_PUBLIC_DELIVERY_MIGRATION.md
Migration state: https://github.com/ChongLiuPhil/Inquiry-Publishing-Project-Starter/blob/main/templates/cloudflare-public-delivery.yaml
